final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---------------- bias network ----------------
MB0  ibias ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=1
* PMOS source bias vbp (10uA)
MB1  vbp   ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=1
MB2  vbp   vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1
* PMOS cascode bias vbpc (high-Vsg diode)
MB3  vbpc  ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=1
MB4  vbpc  vbpc  vdd  vdd pfet W=1.5 L=2
* NMOS cascode bias vbnc (high-Vgs diode)
MB5  vbnc  vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1
MB6  vbnc  vbnc  vss  vss nfet W=0.6 L=2
* ---------------- first stage: folded cascode ----------------
M0   tail  ibias vss  vss nfet W=10 L=1 m=2
M1   x1    vinp  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M2   x2    vinn  tail vss nfet W=10 L=0.5
M3   x1    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1 m=2
M4   x2    vbp   vdd  vdd pfet W=8 L=1 m=2
M5   o1    vbpc  x1   vdd pfet W=8 L=0.5
M6   d2    vbpc  x2   vdd pfet W=8 L=0.5
* low-voltage cascode NMOS mirror (diode side d2, output o1)
M7   d2    vbnc  n2   vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M8   n2    d2    vss  vss nfet W=3 L=1
M9   o1    vbnc  n1   vss nfet W=4 L=0.5
M10  n1    d2    vss  vss nfet W=3 L=1
* ---------------- second stage: PMOS common source ----------------
M11  vout  o1    vdd  vdd pfet W=45 L=0.5
M12  vout  ibias vss  vss nfet W=100 L=1
* ---------------- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----------------
Rz   o1    cz    2000
Cc   cz    vout  2e-12
.ends dut
